title: Mountain Fold
description: The paper folds away from you, making a mountain.

steps.title: Fold behind
steps.instruction: Fold the bottom half behind the top half.
tips: Lift the paper slightly so you can see both edges meet.
mistakes: Folding toward you instead of behind.

steps.title: Unfold
tips: The crease now points up at you like a ridge.
mistakes: Turning the paper over by accident.

steps.title: Turn over
steps.instruction: Turn the paper over, left to right.
tips: From this side the same crease is a valley.

steps.title: Same crease
steps.instruction: Valley fold along the same crease.
tips: A mountain on one side is a valley on the other.
mistakes: Making a new crease next to the old one.
